scenes.line1: What if your task fails at 2 a.m.?
scenes.say: What happens when your Airflow task fails in the middle of the night? Can you trust it to recover or alert you in time?

scenes.label: Retries
scenes.sub: Automatically reruns failed tasks. Set count and delay.
scenes.say: Airflow retries let your task rerun automatically if it fails. You control how many times and how long to wait between tries.

scenes.label: SLA
scenes.sub: Set deadlines for tasks. Get alerts if breached.
scenes.say: Service Level Agreements, or SLAs, define how long a task should take. If it runs late, Airflow can alert you.

rows.b: Send on failure or SLA miss

scenes.say: For alerting, Airflow supports email, Slack, or even custom callbacks. You’ll know right away if something’s wrong.
Here’s how you set three retries, a five minute delay, and a one hour SLA on a task.

scenes.question: Does Airflow alert on every retry?
scenes.wrong: Yes, every retry triggers an alert.
scenes.right: No, alerts fire on final failure or SLA miss, not every retry.
scenes.say: Watch out: Airflow only alerts you when a task finally fails or misses its SLA, not on every retry.
